chunks: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ubayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad, from al-Husayn, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked him about a man who is in an open desert land, and he becomes junub while he has nothing upon him except a garment, and he has become junub in it, and he cannot find water. He said: He performs tayammum and prays naked, standing, gesturing by indication.

key_terms.ثَوْبٌ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.فَأَجْنَبَ: he entered the state of janabah
key_terms.فَلَاةٍ: a barren open land or desert
key_terms.يَتَيَمَّمُ: he performs tayammum as a substitute for wudu or ghusl
key_terms.يُومِئُ إِيمَاءً: he gestures to indicate the prayer actions

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he becomes junub in the desert, has no water, and only has a contaminated garment?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who becomes junub in a desolate place, has only a garment affected by janabah, and cannot find water. The Imam عليه السلام instructs him to perform tayammum and offer salat unclothed while standing and indicating the prayer movements by gesture.
